old_title: Transfer news LIVE: Arsenal prepare record-breaking Vinicius Jr offer
new_title: Transfer news LIVE: Chelsea line up shock double deal, Vinicius Jr to Arsenal latest
old_text:
Arsenal are plotting an audacious move for Real Madrid superstar Vinicius Jr and want to sign the Brazil winger this summer. The Premier League champions are preparing to offer the 26-year-old the biggest contract in their history but have yet to make contact with Real Madrid over the move, who has just one more year on his contract, while incoming boss at the Bernabeu, Jose Mourinho, would need to sanction the transfer.
It could be a busy few weeks for Mikel Arteta's side as they also look to sign Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes and add another centre-back, with England internationals Ezri Konsa and John Stones both of interest. Newcastle manager Eddie Howe confirmed that he wants to keep Guimaraes, but added that his future at the club is out of his control.
Elsewhere, Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola has set out his targets for the transfer window and has confirmed the Reds "definitely need to sign a winger", while France international Bradley Barcola is reportedly open to leaving Paris Saint-Germain this summer. PSG, who are set to miss out on the signing Yan Diomande to Real Madrid, would demand a record fee, however.
Manchester United are still interested in adding another midfielder and have "reached an agreement in principle" with France international Manu Kone, according to reports in Italy. Aurelien Tchouameni remains a target, too.
Follow the latest transfer news, rumours and reports with our live blog below
Real Madrid to hold further Vinicius Jr talks this week
Real Madrid will hold further talks with Vincius Junior's representatives about his future this week as they try and tie him down to a new long-term deal, according to Sky Sports.
Arsenal are interested in Vinicius and are monitoring the situation closely as they reportedly prepare to table the biggest contract in their history to lure the Brazilian.
Spanish outlet Sport says Real Madrid have put a £160m price tag on Vinicius' head, while AS says Vinicius wants to stay in the Spanish capital.
Micky van de Ven hails Spurs 'ambition' after spending spree
Micky van de Ven says Tottenham's spending spree this summer reflects the club's "new ambition" as they look to leave their near-miss with relegation in the past.
"It's really good that you can see the club has made some changes," the 25-year-old told BBC Sport.
"You can see the club has a new ambition. It's something that's really important for players who have been here for a long time.
"Last season was a stressful season, unacceptable from our side, so to leave all of that behind and go into the new season fresh means a lot."
Xabi Alonso outlines plan for Morgan Rogers
Xabi Alonso sees new Chelsea signing Morgan Rogers linking up well with Cole Palmer, insisting the pair can play together.
"In that position we needed an important player and I'm sure there were not many better options than Morgan Rogers," Alonso said.
"You need players who can have that almost instant impact and I'm sure Morgan won't need much time to adapt to the club, the system and his team-mates.
"That was the idea, to get a top player, and Morgan is one of them."
He added: "I have a plan. I have an idea. I can see them linking really well.
"We need to have a good mix. If we get that balance right and those special players in the right positions, with good control, then we will be more competitive with and without the ball."
Juventus rival London clubs for John Stones
Juventus have expressed an interest in signing John Stones on a free transfer.
The defender left Manchester City after 10 years at the end of last season and Sky Sports are reporting that Juve are keen on rivalling Arsenal and Chelsea for his signature.
The 32-year-old just represented England at the World Cup but has spent the last year plagued by injuries.
Real Madrid close in on Yan Diomande
Real Madrid are on the verge of signing Yan Diomande after Paris Saint-Germain pulled out of the deal, according to widespread reports.
The RB Leipzig winger was a previous target of Liverpool, who had a £69m bid rejected for him in June, but now looks set to move to the Bernabeu after agreeing personal terms.
A proposal in excess of £100m has been sent by Real Madrid and while it has not yet received a response from Leipzig, the expectation is that he will move to the Spanish giants.
With PSG out of the picture, the French side look set to reignite their pursuit of Moncaco's Maghnes Akliouche.
Federico Chiesa wants to stay at Liverpool
Federico Chiesa has followed up his pre-season friendly goal against Sunderland by saying he wants to stay at Liverpool and fight for his place under Andoni Iraola.
"Right now, at the moment, I am happy here at Liverpool. I love the club, I love the fans, I love everything," he said.
"I am doing the best I can to have a chance here - and then we will see.
"At the minute, the only thing I am thinking about is Liverpool."
Chelsea told to forget about Granit Xhaka
Sunderland boss Regis Le Bris has told Chelsea that they can forget about trying to sign Granit Xhaka this summer.
"No, this topic is closed," he said when asked about Xhaka.
"He has been really clear about his future. He loves Sunderland, he wants to stay in Sunderland.
"He wants to make the future of Sunderland. He is a good captain. A great leader."
Jermaine Defoe row rages on after Woking exit
Woking's director of football Jody Brown claims Jermain Defoe didn't turn up for work as the row over his departure rages on.
"Jermain's feedback was always positive, and he regularly expressed his enthusiasm and excitement for the season, both publicly and privately. I can therefore appreciate the surprise and subsequent speculation surrounding his sudden departure," Brown said in a statement.
"However, in recent weeks there had been feedback from across the club, including players, staff and other departments, regarding growing concerns. To better understand the situation, I asked Jermain and Paul (Bracewell, assistant) for a brief report outlining the squad's current depth, recruitment targets and any operational challenges, so we could provide the support required and accelerate preparations for the season. That report was requested on more than one occasion but was never received.
"A meeting was subsequently scheduled involving the directors, manager, assistant manager and head of operations to review preparations for the season. Neither Jermain nor his assistant attended that meeting or that day's training session. Throughout his tenure, Jermain had never communicated any serious concerns directly to me, so I am not going to speculate on his reasons.
"Every football club faces challenges. Players want more game time, improved contracts or transfers. The media team might want better equipment, the medical department more interns, the strength and conditioning staff larger gym space. and the car park attendants may want more coffee. But people do not just fail to turn up."
Arsenal ready to offer Vinicius Jr biggest contract in club's history
Arsenal are preparing to offer Vinicius Jr the biggest contract in the club's history to try and sign the Brazilian, according to The Telegraph.
The Brazilian currently commands a wage of £400,000 per week but Arsenal would look to improve those terms to maximise their chances of signing him.
They face a tough task to convince Real to sell, however, with manager Jose Mourinho not wanting to sell Vinicius and wants the superstar winger to line up in attack with Kylian Mbappe and Jude Bellingham next season.
Inter open talks with Spurs over Cristian Romero
Inter Milan have entered talks with Tottenham over the potential signing of captain Cristian Romero, according to the Press Association.
Romero helped Argentina reach a second straight World Cup final earlier this month, but can leave Spurs this summer for a significant fee after an eventful five-year spell.
Centre-back Romero has made 156 appearances since he joined Tottenham in 2021 and guided the club to Europa League success last year, but served four separate suspensions during a difficult 2025-26 campaign.
With Jan Paul van Hecke signed for £52million from Brighton and Marcos Senesi also joining as a free agent in June to boost the defensive options of Roberto De Zerbi's side, Spurs will let Romero depart and his representatives have been in Milan for talks with Inter this weekend.

Chelsea appear set to strike a surprise double deal for England veterans Danny Welbeck and Jordan Henderson as Xabi Alonso seeks to add experience to his squad. The Brighton striker, 35, and Brentford midfielder, 36, could continue an intriguing summer of incomings at Stamford Bridge after the marquee addition of Morgan Rogers earlier in the window.
Arsenal, meanwhile, are plotting an audacious move for Real Madrid superstar Vinicius Jr and want to sign the Brazil winger this summer. The Premier League champions are preparing to offer the 26-year-old the biggest contract in their history but Real Madrid may yet offer the Brazilian fresh terms.
It could be a busy few weeks for Mikel Arteta's side as they also look to sign Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes and add another centre-back, with England internationals Ezri Konsa and John Stones both of interest - though the latter appears bound for Italy. Newcastle manager Eddie Howe confirmed that he wants to keep Guimaraes, but added that his future at the club is out of his control.
Elsewhere, Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola has set out his targets for the transfer window and has confirmed the Reds "definitely need to sign a winger", while France international Bradley Barcola is reportedly open to leaving Paris Saint-Germain this summer. PSG, who are set to miss out on the signing Yan Diomande to Real Madrid, would demand a record fee, however.
Manchester United are still interested in adding another midfielder and have "reached an agreement in principle" with France international Manu Kone, according to reports in Italy. Aurelien Tchouameni remains a target, too.
Follow the latest transfer news, rumours and reports with our live blog below
Mohamed Salah's move to Besiktas breaks down
Also on the hunt for a new club is Mohamed Salah - though it appears Besiktas won't be his next employers. Media in Turkey report that club director Onder Ozen has paused negotiations having been unhappy over the demands of Salah's agent.
John Stones in talks with Inter Milan
John Stones is available on a free after reaching the end of his Manchester City contract, and the Telegraph believe Inter Milan may be his next club. Arsenal had been keen on the experienced centre-half after William Saliba's injury.
Manchester United in talks to loan striker
Manchester United are in advanced talks to send Joshua Zirkzee, 25, on a season-long loan to Juventus, according to The Sun. The reported deal for the Netherlands forward includes an option to buy for £30m.
Man City continue talks with Ayyoub Bouaddi as Josko Gvardiol nears contract extension
Manchester City are still in direct talks with Lille over a move for World Cup breakout star Ayyoub Bouaddi, according to Fabrizio Romano.
City are the club most interested in the Moroccan but could opt for him to join in 2027 rather than this summer.
Meanwhile, Josko Gvardiol is set to sign a contract extension at the Etihad until 2031.
Leeds close in on James Trafford
James Trafford's search for a new club could soon be over with Leeds set to announce his signing. The goalkeeper's return to Manchester City lasted just one season, and a fee of £40m has been mooted by The Athletic.
Liverpool learn Bradley Barcola price
Widespread reports suggest that Paris Saint-Germain are open to selling Bradley Barcola - but only for a fee of around £145m or more. The Times suggest that Arsenal and Liverpool both have interest, though may be unwilling to pay the terms PSG desire with the French capital club using the Morgan Rogers and Elliot Anderson deals as a benchmark.
Negotiations continue for Yan Diomande
Real Madrid appear to have won the race for the in-demand Yan Diomande, though negotiations continue over the fee for the RB Leipzig winger. Sky Sport in Germany believe a deal is not yet totally done for the Ivorian, a top talent who was strongly linked with Liverpool earlier in the year.
Manchester City braced for offer for Rodri from Real Madrid
Real Madrid have been strongly linked with World Cup winner Rodri this summer, and Manchester City are said by The Guardian to be bracing for an offer for the Spanish midfielder.
Real Madrid to hold contract talks with Vinicius Jr amid Arsenal interest
Could Real Madrid yet see off Arsenal's interest and keep Vinicius Jr? Sky Sports reports that new contract talks are planned with the Brazilian's representatives with hope of a breakthrough.
Chelsea target Jordan Henderson to add experience to their squad
Widespread reports also suggest Chelsea are hoping to sign Jordan Henderson, who may be available on a free transfer from Brentford. The 36-year-old was part of England's World Cup squad and would add more experience to Xabi Alonso's squad.
